scope: Fresh strength-interpolation assay with a fixed reader restricted to cells receiving no direct channel inhibition; numerical qualification and decoding outcomes are separate.
purpose: Test whether both location and timing can be read outside the two directly stimulated cells, and report the same restricted readout with junctions disconnected. Keep an explicitly separate all-cell comparator on the same panel.

cue.dose: Source j receives amplitude * share_j * minimum_source_area / source_area_j fractional channel inhibition for the same 8-us pulse; total area-integrated inhibition is unchanged.
cue.timing: Location-only retains the fixed 16-24-us pulse; other cued arms retain early 8-16-us or late 24-32-us pulses. Readout remains 40,48,64 us.

readout.support: All five unstimulated cells, selected before fresh responses. Both voltage and input-only primary-support modes exclude source cells. Input history on this support is a null control, not source control history.

reader.calibration: Fit the unchanged three-strength polyline separately in each arm and observation mode at dt=0.0625 us; calibration and evaluation share this exact step. All label combinations are calibrated; unused single-task duplicates are excluded.
reader.features: Primary: 15 area-weighted membrane-voltage values from unstimulated cells 2,3,5,6,7 at 40,48,64 us, in time-first order. The separate all-cell comparator uses 21 values and cannot enter the primary fit. No feature search or fitted scaling.
reader.prediction: Project each observed vector onto each adjacent calibration segment with its coordinate clipped to [0,1]. For each task, take the minimum distance among curves with label 0 and label 1. Score=(distance_0-distance_1)/2; positive predicts 1, otherwise 0. Prediction accepts features only: no evaluation strength, labels, IDs or paired counterpart.
reader.margin: Resolved only when abs(score) exceeds the declared margin. Half the distance gap is in feature units and is 1-Lipschitz for fixed curves; it is not a biological noise model or a guarantee of correct generalization. Distances and inferred segment coordinates are retained.
reader.shuffles: Permute whole curve label pairs with the fixed seeds after fitting vertices. This preserves each physical response curve and the balanced label set. Duplicate permutations and the identity are retained; no significance claim.

generalization: Held-out strengths 0.4375,0.5625,0.6375,0.7625 are disjoint from all preceding panels and chosen symmetrically around 0.6 before response simulation. Generalization is within one deterministic tissue and all-combinations calibration, not independent biological replication or untrained input combinations.
scientific_target: Report whether both labels are correct and resolved for all 16 fresh joint cases using ONLY the 15 primary features at the unchanged 2-nV margin. Report disconnected and all-cell outcomes separately, including every failure and abstention. Reader success is never an engineering acceptance gate.

historical_reproduction.comparison: All calibration worlds match saved finest-step physical inputs and reproduce full same-backend trajectories under inherited field-specific tolerances. Report bitwise agreement separately. This does not supply new holdouts or certify the restricted reader at other timesteps.

storage: Stream all 140 full trajectories per backend to disk in four-world batches; retain only readout vectors and four joint calibration worlds for replay. CPU/L4 comparisons load one world at a time.
scope_exclusions: No physical model, geometry, initial-state, 75/25 allocation, total-dose, pulse-time, 64-us-horizon, reader-algorithm, margin or numerical-tolerance changes.

Use the finest previously tested step, 0.0625 us, for both calibration and evaluation. This is an explicit operating point, not a continuum error bound or independent convergence certificate for the new strengths and restricted readout.
No fresh-response simulation or inspection during development. Nonintegrating control/resource checks, synthetic known answers and authenticated prior evidence precede frozen-source launch.

No feature subset search, adaptive template density, threshold tuning, strength input to prediction, evaluation-label fitting or feedback to physics. The all-cell comparator never supplies primary features or calibration.

A disconnected control leaves extracellular/electrical routes and shared environmental coupling. Removing directly stimulated observations does not by itself establish that junction communication is required; per-arm calibration does not test reader transfer.

One passive external decoder producing two labels is not two causal biological consumers or evidence of biological polycomputing, memory, reconstruction or heredity. The synthetic 2-nV margin is not measured biological sensor noise.
All seven reader modes and 32 predeclared whole-curve label shuffles are reported without selecting a favorable result; shuffles do not establish significance.
Every arm has equal solver steps. Record both GPU-busy and measured SM-active with coverage, including compilation and host work; no throughput or multi-GPU qualification.
